title: Logotype / Please don’t
slide_intent: Show prohibited transformations because attractive variations can still damage a shared signature.
strategic_value: A concrete misuse set can reduce inconsistent Duolingo marks across contributors.
demonstration: Nine examples pair altered logotypes with prohibitions covering color, squash, font substitution, outline, images, busy background, skew, gradients and spacing.
practical_value: Compare a proposed treatment against the pictured misuse types.

content_islands.name: Misuse grid
content_islands.spec: Arrange nine crossed-out logotypes in a three-column grid on the left.

content_islands.name: Prohibition list
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and nine matching prohibitions in the right column.

reference_purposes.Application: Each visual example demonstrates a specific form of misuse.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The page prohibits the nine listed alterations and specifies accepted rotations of 0° and 90°.

ingredient.name: Logotype integrity
ingredient.application: Do not recolor beyond approved options, distort, substitute fonts, outline, image-fill, gradient-fill, skew, alter spacing or place over a busy background.
ingredient.scope: Historical archived guidelines. Historical logotype rules; accepted rotations are 0° and 90°.
